nodes.label: plan/index.ts
nodes.description: Entry point for the plan page; wires all sub-modules, exposes window.PlanApp, and auto-initializes on DOMContentLoaded.

nodes.label: plan/helpers.ts
nodes.description: Pure utility module: data-loading helpers (users, articles, financial/cost centers), article tree builder, toast/notification functions, and shared TypeScript interfaces.

nodes.label: plan/analytics.ts
nodes.description: ECharts-based analytics module: loads monthly comparison data, manages filter dropdowns (CFO, article type, article), renders two charts, handles month-button navigation.

nodes.label: plan/filterAnalyticsSync.ts
nodes.description: Bidirectional sync module between filter section and analytics section; uses isSyncInProgress mutex and debounced wrappers to prevent cascading loops.

nodes.label: plan/filters.ts
nodes.description: Filter state manager: holds PlanFilters state, exposes getFilters/setFilters/resetFilterState, reads/writes UI form elements, dispatches filtersChanged events.

nodes.label: plan/factsTable.ts
nodes.description: Facts table module: loads first page and subsequent pages of plan facts from API, renders desktop+mobile HTML, manages selection state (selectedFactIds) and remindersMap, supports incremental row injection.

nodes.label: plan/crud.ts
nodes.description: CRUD operations for budget plans: create/edit/delete single facts, batch delete, recurring plan management, edit modal management with ChoicesCategoryTree and CalendarWidget.

nodes.label: plan/wsEventHandlers.ts
nodes.description: WebSocket event handler registration for real-time plan table updates; uses incremental row injection for single-fact events and debounced full reload for batch/recurring events.

nodes.label: plan/planModal.ts
nodes.description: Modal helper module: financial/cost center dropdowns for edit modal, recurring plan table rendering, reminder field population, CalendarWidget init for edit reminder, period buttons setup.

nodes.label: plan/analyticsArticleChoices.ts
nodes.description: Thin wrapper that creates/re-creates a BudgetShared.ChoicesCategoryTree instance on the #analytics-article select element.

nodes.label: plan/adapters/windowExports.ts
nodes.description: Adapter that assigns all plan module functions to window globals (window.PlanApp, window.showEditModal, window.deleteFact, etc.) so inline onclick handlers can resolve them.

nodes.label: plan/adapters/eventDelegation.ts
nodes.description: Event delegation adapter: single document click listener dispatching data-action values (apply-filters, reset-filters, collapse-filters, export-csv, batch-delete) to module functions.

nodes.label: initialize()
nodes.description: Main page initialization: sets up event delegation, calendar, analytics buttons, Dexie, dropdowns, initial data load, analytics, and WS handlers in sequence.

nodes.label: applyFiltersAndLoadData()
nodes.description: Orchestrator: calls PlanFilters.applyFilters(), then PlanFactsTable.loadFacts(), then FilterAnalyticsSync.debouncedSyncFiltersToAnalytics().

nodes.label: syncFiltersToAnalytics(options?)
nodes.description: Reads filter state and pushes date range, article type, article, and FC values into analytics UI; reloads charts if any value changed; guarded by isSyncInProgress mutex.

nodes.label: syncAnalyticsToFilters(options?)
nodes.description: Reads analytics state and pushes date range, article type, article, and FC values into filter UI; reloads facts table if any value changed; guarded by isSyncInProgress mutex.

nodes.label: debouncedSyncFiltersToAnalytics(options?,delay?)
nodes.description: 300ms debounce wrapper around syncFiltersToAnalytics to prevent cascading reloads during rapid filter changes.

nodes.label: SyncOptions interface
nodes.description: Options bag for sync functions: skipReload, updateMonth, updateDateRange, skipFiltersSync — controls which parts of the bidirectional sync execute.

nodes.label: skipFiltersSync option
nodes.description: When true in syncAnalyticsToFilters, skips steps 2-4 (article type, article, FC propagation to filter section); only date range is updated — used when switching analytics month.

nodes.label: selectAnalyticsMonth(month, btn)
nodes.description: Handles month-button click: updates currentAnalyticsMonth, cascades filter-options reload (FC→type→article), calls loadPlanAnalytics(), then syncAnalyticsToFilters({skipFiltersSync:true}).

nodes.label: loadPlanAnalytics()
nodes.description: Fetches monthly-comparison data from /api/v1/analytics/plans/monthly-comparison, updates summary cards, initializes and updates both ECharts instances.

nodes.label: loadAnalyticsFilterOptions(params?)
nodes.description: Fetches or returns cached PlanFilterOptionsResponse from /api/v1/analytics/plans/filter-options; caches result only when called with no params.

nodes.label: loadAnalyticsArticleFilter(articleType?, allArticles?)
nodes.description: Populates the analytics article dropdown: fetches full hierarchy from API when articleType is set, uses pre-fetched articles otherwise, then calls initAnalyticsArticleChoices.

nodes.label: initAnalyticsArticleChoices(articles, articleType)
nodes.description: Destroys any existing ChoicesCategoryTree instance on #analytics-article and creates a new one with the given type filter.

nodes.label: loadFacts()
nodes.description: Resets pagination state, fetches first page of plan facts using current filter state, loads reminders, renders table, and updates stats/load-more button.

nodes.label: fetchAndInjectPlanRow(planId, operation)
nodes.description: Incremental update: fetches row HTML from /api/v1/facts/{id}/row-html and prepends (create) or replaces (update) the row without a full table reload; falls back to false if on filtered/non-first page.

nodes.label: removePlanRow(planId)
nodes.description: Fade-removes desktop tr and mobile div for a plan row from the DOM; decrements totalFacts/loadedCount counters.

nodes.label: registerWSHandlers()
nodes.description: Registers all plan-related WebSocket event handlers on window.budgetWSClient (plan_created, plan_updated, plan_deleted, recurring_plan_*, facts_batch_deleted, transfer_created).

nodes.label: setupWindowExports(planApp)
nodes.description: Assigns entire PlanApp namespace plus individual function aliases (window.showEditModal, window.deleteFact, etc.) and state objects (ModalListenerManager, allCategories) to window.

nodes.label: setupEventDelegation()
nodes.description: Attaches a single document-level click listener (idempotent) that dispatches data-action attribute values to corresponding plan module functions.

nodes.label: onAnalyticsCFOChange()
nodes.description: CFO dropdown change handler: reloads filter-options for current month+FC, repopulates article type and article dropdowns, reloads full analytics, then syncs to filters (no date update).

nodes.label: onAnalyticsArticleTypeChange()
nodes.description: Article type dropdown change handler: reloads article filter for selected type or full plan-filtered list, loads categories chart data, then syncs to filters (no date update).

nodes.label: onAnalyticsArticleChange()
nodes.description: Article dropdown change handler: reloads categories chart data, then syncs to filters (no date update).

nodes.label: loadCategoriesChartData()
nodes.description: Loads monthly-comparison data filtered by article type and article ID, updates only the categories chart without touching the comparison chart.

nodes.label: isSyncInProgress mutex
nodes.description: Module-level boolean flag shared by both syncFiltersToAnalytics and syncAnalyticsToFilters to prevent infinite mutual recursion during bidirectional sync.

nodes.label: selectedFactIds (Set)
nodes.description: Exported mutable Set of currently checked fact IDs; shared live binding consumed by crud.ts for batch delete operations.

nodes.label: remindersMap (Map)
nodes.description: Exported Map from fact ID to Reminder; populated after each loadFacts(); consumed by crud.ts to prefill edit modal reminder fields without extra API calls.

nodes.label: window.PlanApp
nodes.description: Global public API object assembled in index.ts and assigned to window by setupWindowExports; provides access to all plan modules and functions from inline onclick handlers and external scripts.

nodes.label: PlanFilters interface
nodes.description: TypeScript interface defining the filter state shape: user_id, article_id, article_type, date_from, date_to, financial_center_id, cost_center_id, search, has_recurring_plan, has_reminder.

nodes.label: ShoppingListItemService
nodes.summary: Service layer for ShoppingListItem CRUD with batch operations, soft delete, offline sync, and conflict resolution.

nodes.label: batch_complete_items
nodes.summary: Mark multiple shopping list items as completed or uncompleted in a single batch operation.

nodes.label: batch_delete_items
nodes.summary: Soft-delete multiple shopping list items by setting deleted_at timestamp.

nodes.label: restore_item
nodes.summary: Restore a soft-deleted shopping list item, idempotent if item is already active.

nodes.label: mark_items_pending
nodes.summary: Mark items as pending sync for offline-first functionality.

nodes.label: get_pending_sync_items
nodes.summary: Retrieve all items with pending sync status, optionally filtered by shopping list ID.

nodes.label: detect_conflicts
nodes.summary: Detect items with sync_status='conflict' in a given shopping list.

nodes.label: resolve_conflict
nodes.summary: Resolve a sync conflict using server, client, or manual-merge strategy.

nodes.label: get_items_by_completion_status
nodes.summary: Filter shopping list items by completed/incomplete status.

nodes.label: get_items_by_store
nodes.summary: Filter shopping list items by store, ordered by product group and name.

nodes.label: get_items_by_product_group
nodes.summary: Filter shopping list items by product group (category).

nodes.label: CSVImporter
nodes.summary: Multi-step CSV import wizard (5 steps: upload, auto-detect, column mapping, preview/validate, execute) with Web Worker support for large files.

nodes.label: CSVImporter.encodeBase64
nodes.summary: Encode file content to Base64 using Web Worker for large files (>1MB), falls back to synchronous btoa.

nodes.label: CSVImporter.analyzeFile
nodes.summary: Call backend /import/analyze API for CSV auto-detection with client-side fallback on failure.

nodes.label: CSVImporter.executeImport
nodes.summary: Execute CSV import via /import/execute API, then reload list items, stores, product groups, and re-render UI.

nodes.label: ImportManager
nodes.summary: Orchestrates CSV and Google Sheets import methods, showing method-selection step before delegating to CSVImporter or GoogleSheetsImporter.

nodes.label: ImportManager.selectMethod
nodes.summary: Instantiate and delegate to CSVImporter or GoogleSheetsImporter based on user-selected import method.

nodes.label: listOperations
nodes.summary: Core CRUD operations for shopping list items using Dexie-first strategy with API fallback and optimistic UI updates.

nodes.label: createItem
nodes.summary: Create a shopping list item in Dexie first, then background-upload to server API.

nodes.label: updateItem
nodes.summary: Update a shopping list item in Dexie first, then background-upload to server API.

nodes.label: toggleItemCompleted
nodes.summary: Toggle item completion with optimistic DOM update and Dexie-first persistence; reverts on error.

nodes.label: deleteItem
nodes.summary: Delete a shopping list item with optional confirmation dialog, Dexie-first soft delete.

nodes.label: deleteMultipleItems
nodes.summary: Bulk-delete multiple items using Dexie parallel soft-delete with API fallback for items missing temp_id.

nodes.label: refreshUI
nodes.summary: Centralized UI refresh after state changes: calls renderCurrentView, updateFABButtons, updateFABVisibility.

nodes.label: hierarchyIntegration
nodes.summary: Compatibility layer between modular TypeScript structure and the legacy HierarchyView class.

nodes.label: createListsManagerProxy
nodes.summary: Create a proxy object that adapts modular state/functions to the legacy listsManager interface expected by HierarchyView and ImportManager.

nodes.label: initializeHierarchyView
nodes.summary: Initialize HierarchyView with listsManager proxy and store in global state; exports to window.hierarchyView.

nodes.label: updateHierarchyToggleButton
nodes.summary: Update expand/collapse toggle button state based on ratio of expanded to total hierarchy nodes.

nodes.label: listRenderer
nodes.summary: Orchestrates landing view (list cards) and detail view (items), handles FAB visibility, view switching, and breadcrumb updates.

nodes.label: renderShoppingListCards
nodes.summary: Render the grid of shopping list cards on the landing view with progress bars and event listeners.

nodes.label: renderLandingView
nodes.summary: Show the landing view, reset state, close import wizard, and reload shopping lists from API.

nodes.label: renderDetailView
nodes.summary: Show detail view for a specific shopping list, applies syncViewUI before making containers visible to prevent FOUC.

nodes.label: switchView
nodes.summary: Switch between table and hierarchy views; mobile always forces hierarchy view.

nodes.label: updateFABVisibility
nodes.summary: Show or hide FAB Speed Dial based on whether user is in detail view.

nodes.label: refreshDashboard
nodes.summary: Reload shopping list cards when a WebSocket event signals a list was created, updated, or deleted.

nodes.label: modalManager
nodes.summary: Manages all modal dialogs for the lists feature: create/edit/delete list, add/edit/delete item, Choices.js initialization, and duplicate detection.

nodes.label: handleCreateList
nodes.summary: Handle create list form: POST to API, optimistically update state, sync to Dexie, then open new list in detail view.

nodes.label: handleSaveItem
nodes.summary: Handle item form submission for both create and edit paths.

nodes.label: confirmDeleteList
nodes.summary: Delete a shopping list via API, invalidate Dexie cache, then reload landing view; supports offline soft-delete fallback.

nodes.label: initStoreChoices
nodes.summary: Initialize Choices.js dropdown for the store selector in the item modal.

nodes.label: initProductGroupChoices
nodes.summary: Initialize Choices.js dropdown for hierarchical product group selector in the item modal.

nodes.label: searchDuplicate
nodes.summary: Check for duplicate item in current list via /api/v1/shopping-list-items/check-duplicate API.

nodes.label: detail_view.html
nodes.summary: Jinja2 partial template for the shopping list detail view: breadcrumb, import wizard, search field, toolbar, table view, and hierarchy view.

edges.description: index.ts calls setupWindowExports(planApp) to expose the assembled API to window after module initialization.
index.ts imports PlanHelpers namespace for data loading (loadUsers, loadArticles, etc.) and notifications.
index.ts imports PlanAnalytics namespace for analytics initialization and exposure via window.PlanApp.
index.ts imports FilterAnalyticsSync namespace and exposes its public functions via window.PlanApp.
index.ts imports PlanFilters namespace for filter initialization and exposure via window.PlanApp.
index.ts imports PlanFactsTable namespace for facts loading and exposure via window.PlanApp.
index.ts imports PlanCRUD namespace for CRUD operations and exposure via window.PlanApp.
windowExports.ts imports PlanHelpers to expose showNotification and getReminderStatusBadge as window globals.
analytics.ts imports initAnalyticsArticleChoices and calls it whenever the article filter list needs to be rebuilt.
filterAnalyticsSync.ts imports PlanAnalytics for getCurrentAnalyticsMonth, setCurrentAnalyticsMonth, loadPlanAnalytics, and loadAnalyticsFilterOptions.
filterAnalyticsSync.ts imports PlanFilters for getFilters/setFilters operations during bidirectional sync.
filterAnalyticsSync.ts imports PlanFactsTable.loadFacts() to trigger facts table reload from syncAnalyticsToFilters.
eventDelegation.ts imports FilterAnalyticsSync to call debouncedSyncFiltersToAnalytics after filter actions.
crud.ts imports FilterAnalyticsSync.debouncedSyncFiltersToAnalytics() to refresh analytics after CRUD operations.
eventDelegation.ts imports PlanFilters for applyFilters/resetFilters/collapseFilters.
factsTable.ts imports PlanFilters.getFilters() to build API query params in buildFactsApiUrl.
eventDelegation.ts imports PlanFactsTable to call loadFacts() on filter apply/reset actions.
crud.ts imports PlanFactsTable for getFactsData(), loadFacts(), and shared state (remindersMap, selectedFactIds).
wsEventHandlers.ts imports PlanFactsTable for loadFacts, fetchAndInjectPlanRow, and removePlanRow.
crud.ts calls debouncedSyncFiltersToAnalytics() after deleteFact to refresh analytics chart after data changes.
crud.ts calls PlanFactsTable.loadFacts() after create/update/delete/batch operations to refresh the table.
crud.ts imports selectedFactIds from factsTable.ts to read selected IDs for batch delete.
crud.ts imports remindersMap from factsTable.ts to check existing reminders when opening edit modal.
eventDelegation.ts imports PlanCRUD to dispatch batch-delete action to batchDeleteFacts().
WS handlers for plan_created and plan_updated call fetchAndInjectPlanRow() to attempt incremental table update before falling back to full reload.
WS handler for plan_deleted calls removePlanRow() to fade-remove the row without a full reload.
debouncedReloadFacts in wsEventHandlers calls loadFacts() as fallback when incremental injection fails or for batch/recurring events.
windowExports.ts imports PlanModal to assign modal helpers (loadFinancialCenters, loadCostCenters, ModalListenerManager, etc.) to window globals.
setupWindowExports() assigns the planApp object to window.PlanApp, creating the public global API.
Event delegation's applyFilters/resetFilters local functions call debouncedSyncFiltersToAnalytics() after reloading facts.
Event delegation's local applyFilters and resetFilters call PlanFactsTable.loadFacts() after applying or resetting filters.
initialize() calls setupEventDelegation() as first setup step.
initialize() calls registerWSHandlers() after initial data load to set up real-time updates.
initialize() calls PlanAnalytics.loadPlanAnalytics() in the post-init parallel Promise.all.
initialize() calls applyFiltersAndLoadData() to load initial facts after dropdowns are ready.
applyFiltersAndLoadData() calls PlanFactsTable.loadFacts() after applying filters.
applyFiltersAndLoadData() triggers debouncedSyncFiltersToAnalytics() after reloading facts.
debouncedSyncFiltersToAnalytics() schedules and eventually calls syncFiltersToAnalytics() after 300ms.
syncFiltersToAnalytics() calls loadPlanAnalytics() when needsReload is true and skipReload is false.
syncFiltersToAnalytics() checks and sets isSyncInProgress mutex to prevent re-entrant calls.
syncFiltersToAnalytics() reads PlanFilters.getFilters() to extract date range, article type, article ID, and FC for analytics sync.
The two functions form a bidirectional sync pair; both share the isSyncInProgress mutex to prevent each from triggering the other in an infinite loop.
window.PlanApp.syncFiltersToAnalytics is exposed on window for external callers and inline onclick handlers.
syncAnalyticsToFilters() calls PlanFactsTable.loadFacts() when needsReload is true and skipReload is false.
syncAnalyticsToFilters() checks and sets isSyncInProgress mutex to prevent re-entrant calls.
syncAnalyticsToFilters() reads skipFiltersSync from SyncOptions to decide whether to propagate article/type/FC values to filter section.
selectAnalyticsMonth() calls window.PlanApp.syncAnalyticsToFilters({skipFiltersSync: true}) after reloading analytics, syncing only the date range.
onAnalyticsCFOChange() calls syncAnalyticsToFilters({updateDateRange: false}) via syncToFiltersNoDateUpdate helper.
onAnalyticsArticleTypeChange() calls syncAnalyticsToFilters({updateDateRange: false}) via syncToFiltersNoDateUpdate.
onAnalyticsArticleChange() calls syncAnalyticsToFilters({updateDateRange: false}) via syncToFiltersNoDateUpdate.
syncAnalyticsToFilters() calls PlanFilters.setFilters() to update filter state when syncing analytics selections back to filters.
window.PlanApp.syncAnalyticsToFilters is the public entry point used by analytics.ts to call syncAnalyticsToFilters without a direct module import (avoids circular dependency).
skipFiltersSync is a field of the SyncOptions interface controlling article/type/FC propagation in syncAnalyticsToFilters.
selectAnalyticsMonth() passes {skipFiltersSync: true} to syncAnalyticsToFilters so that switching months only updates the date range, not article/type/FC filters.
selectAnalyticsMonth() calls loadPlanAnalytics() after updating filter dropdowns for the new month.
selectAnalyticsMonth() calls loadAnalyticsFilterOptions({planning_month}) to get dynamic filter options for the newly selected month.
selectAnalyticsMonth() calls loadAnalyticsArticleFilter() to repopulate the article dropdown after month selection.
onAnalyticsCFOChange() calls loadPlanAnalytics() after updating filter dropdowns.
onAnalyticsCFOChange() calls loadAnalyticsFilterOptions() with current month+FC to get updated article types and articles.
loadAnalyticsArticleFilter() always calls initAnalyticsArticleChoices() with the resolved articles list to create/recreate the ChoicesCategoryTree widget.
onAnalyticsArticleTypeChange() calls loadAnalyticsArticleFilter() with the selected type to refresh the article dropdown.
loadFacts() calls PlanFilters.getFilters() to build the API query URL from current filter state.
onAnalyticsArticleTypeChange() calls loadCategoriesChartData() to refresh categories chart with the new type filter.
onAnalyticsArticleChange() calls loadCategoriesChartData() to apply the article filter to categories chart.
